title: jint_strict silently defaults string/bool/null sim values instead of fail-fast — a string "volume": "2" loads as 0 with ok=true
detail: A string/bool/null/array JSON value falls through the #partial switch and returns (def, true): "volume": "2" loads as 0, "start_tick": "1200" as 0, "multiplier": "10" as 1 — silent defaults, exactly the ODN-5 bar this loader claims to enforce.
recommended_fix: Add a default case: in jint_strict returning (0, false) so any non-Integer value rejects; add a string-typed row ("volume": "2") to the negative table.

title: Demand loader silently accepts wrong-typed entries/set_pieces keys and skips non-object rows — inconsistent with the strict eras/packet_types checks in the same block
detail: A wrong-typed "entries"/"set_pieces" key or a non-object row is silently accepted as empty, while the same block hard-rejects bad "eras" and packet_types hard-rejects bad entries — malformed demand loads with zero specs, no error.
recommended_fix: Reject wrong-typed collection keys and non-object elements: mirror the "eras"/packet_types strict checks (if !oke return ...) and replace or_continue with a named error.
